text: The Willow planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover about 26 modules and list corrected config values, including catalog ttl_s 390, session ttl_s 330, and upload batch_size 700. Ownership is split across four workers: gamma takes audit, quota, and ingest; delta takes search, billing, and sync; alpha takes shipping; and beta takes inventory. Separation-of-duties rules keep several module pairs on different workers. Dependency rules forbid paths from archive to media, reports to scheduler, pricing to reports, and gateway to indexer. Client requirements set archive queue_depth at 450, quota max_workers at 20, ingest max_workers at 16, and search batch_size at 400. Rollout requires shipping and session to precede indexer. Other decisions: the security review is at month end, no Rust rewrites this quarter, the linter is undecided, code review turnaround stays under a day, and the budget review moved to next Thursday.
